rows.commentary: 5.2: Blair Tickner chases Ishan Kishan with a short delivery outside leg, forcing the batter to lift a leg before pulling straight to the deep backward square-leg fielder.
5.3: Blair Tickner drops it back on the body, allowing Shreyas Iyer to shift to the back foot and smoothly tuck it into the backward square leg region.
5.4: Blair Tickner pitches too straight, and Ishan Kishan exploits the angle on an off-stump length delivery to whip it wide of short fine leg for a boundary.
5.5: Blair Tickner targets outside off with a short-of-length ball, met by Ishan Kishan on the back foot with a cut directly to the fielder at deep point.
5.6: Blair Tickner fires a tight length delivery on off, prompting Shreyas Iyer to stride forward and defensively return it straight back with utmost respect.
6.1: Mitchell Santner watches Finn Allen leap near the boundary and juggle the ball while his foot grazes the turf, ultimately granting Ishan Kishan a six after a tense third-umpire review.
6.2: Mitchell Santner keeps it flat and back of a length outside off, enabling Ishan Kishan to step back and carve a cut toward sweeper cover.
6.3: Mitchell Santner floats a full delivery on middle, and Shreyas Iyer pushes forward to ease an off-drive out toward long-off.
6.4: Mitchell Santner loops one full outside off, where Ishan Kishan charges down and loses his bottom hand on the loft, though athletic fielding at long-off restricts the damage to a single.
6.5: Mitchell Santner delivers a flat, short-of-length ball on middle that Shreyas Iyer nudges off the back foot toward mid-wicket as the bowler gives chase.
6.6: Mitchell Santner attacks outside off on a flat length, and Ishan Kishan rocks back to crack a hard cut straight to sweeper cover.
7.1: Michael Bracewell drops this on a good length outside off, and Ishan Kishan retreats to the back foot, whipping it cleanly through mid-wicket for a single.
7.2: Michael Bracewell drops short, and Shreyas Iyer instantly swivels on the back foot to launch a vicious pull that sails deep over mid-wicket into the crowd.
7.3: Michael Bracewell flings this flat delivery miles outside the tramline, leaving Shreyas Iyer to watch it sail past for a wide.
7.3: Michael Bracewell offers width outside off, prompting Shreyas Iyer to reach out and slash a bouncing drive towards sweeper cover for a single.
7.4: No run for Ishan Kishan off Michael Bracewell.
7.5: Ishan Kishan takes a single off Michael Bracewell.
17.4: Jacob Duffy delivers a slower ball on a short length outside off, allowing Naman Dhir to plant his front foot, wait for the delivery, and launch it powerfully over extra cover for four.
17.5: Jacob Duffy fires in a sharp, rising bouncer outside off that beats Naman Dhir's attempted ramp shot, leaving the batter unsuccessfully appealing for a wide.
17.6: Jacob Duffy bowls a full delivery outside off which Naman Dhir tries to scoop from across his crease, only for the ball to slip directly through his legs to the wicketkeeper.
18.1: Tickner unfurls the slower knuckle-ball full outside off, and Reddy drives low off the bottom edge toward long-on where Mitchell smartly gets his body behind the bouncing ball.
18.2: Blair Tickner strays with a knee-high full toss on middle stump, and Naman Dhir uses the bowler's pace to whip a massive top-edge fifteen rows deep over fine leg for six.
18.3: Blair Tickner tests Naman Dhir with a short-of-length slower ball outside off, past which the batter slashes and misses entirely.
18.4: Blair Tickner claims his wicket as Naman Dhir slices a knuckle ball high into the air, allowing Michael Bracewell to sprint back from extra cover and dive forward for a brilliant catch.
18.5: Blair Tickner drops it on a short of length outside off, prompting Bhuvneshwar Kumar to move onto the back foot and steer it neatly down to third man.
18.6: Blair Tickner serves up a short, wide slower ball that Nitish Kumar Reddy reaches for, sending a thick top-edge sailing over the keeper toward the third-man boundary.
19.1: Adam Milne lands a length delivery on middle, and Bhuvneshwar Kumar creates room to loft it toward deep point for a single.
19.2: Adam Milne strikes as Nitish Kumar Reddy fails to get under a full ball on his pads, heaving it straight to Glenn Phillips at deep mid-wicket for a comfortable catch.
19.3: Adam Milne angles a short-of-length delivery outside off that Prince Yadav flashes at and misses, before Tim Seifert makes a mess of the take to concede a bye.
19.4: Four to Bhuvneshwar Kumar off Adam Milne.
5.6: Bhuvneshwar Kumar drifts wide with the yorker, and Tim Seifert carves the fuller delivery over short third man for four.
6.1: Varun Chakaravarthy strikes the pad of an advancing Daryl Mitchell, but replays vindicate the batsman with an inside edge on review.
6.2: Varun Chakaravarthy spears a flat googly into the stumps, pushed comfortably by Tim Seifert to long-on.
6.3: Varun Chakaravarthy strays sharply down the leg side, awarding an extra run as Daryl Mitchell leaves it alone.
6.3: Varun Chakaravarthy fires it back of a length, and Daryl Mitchell turns it from the inside half through midwicket.
6.4: Varun Chakaravarthy tosses up a turning legbreak, worked neatly down to long-on by Tim Seifert.
6.5: Daryl Mitchell dances down the pitch to Varun Chakaravarthy and whips a majestic six sailing over long-on.
6.6: Varun Chakaravarthy appeals in vain as Daryl Mitchell defends a googly missing comfortably outside off.
7.1: Prince Yadav cramps Tim Seifert for room with a length delivery that rattles into the pads.
7.2: Prince Yadav attacks the leg stump, allowing Tim Seifert to clear his front leg and sweep to deep midwicket.
7.3: Prince Yadav strays with a low full toss down leg, glancing off Daryl Mitchell's pad for a leg bye.
7.4: Daryl Mitchell dismisses a short delivery from Prince Yadav with a ferocious pull soaring over the ropes for six.
7.5: Prince Yadav drops a full toss right into the hitting arc on middle and leg, allowing Daryl Mitchell to punch it firmly down to long-on for a single.
7.6: Prince Yadav serves up a very full delivery on middle and leg, prompting Tim Seifert to back away and carve it hard out to deep point.
8.1: Varun Chakaravarthy drags this one short, and Tim Seifert swings violently across the line, only to chop it off the under-edge straight into his pad.
8.2: Varun Chakaravarthy keeps it tight, inducing a gentle push from Tim Seifert out toward deep backward point for a single.
16.6: Arshdeep Singh delivers full just outside off, and Phillips punches it toward sweeper cover for a single to hold the strike.
17.1: Bhuvneshwar Kumar drops it short, and Phillips pulls to deep square where Abhishek fumbles, allowing the historic second run that crowns him the series run-scoring king.
17.2: Bhuvneshwar Kumar fires a wide full toss that Phillips reaches out to slice towards the left of short third.
17.3: Bhuvneshwar Kumar slips in a sluggish bouncer that sails past Phillips' attempted ramp over the wicketkeeper.
17.4: Bhuvneshwar Kumar nails a precise yorker into the stumps which Phillips manages to jam back toward the bowler.
17.5: Bhuvneshwar Kumar drifts onto the pads, and Phillips cleverly tickles it down to the fine leg boundary to level the scores.
17.6: Bhuvneshwar Kumar offers a short delivery that Phillips expertly glides past short third to seal a seven-wicket victory for New Zealand, though India claims the series 3-2.
